name: 5-Amino-1MQ
short_description: 5-Amino-1MQ is an experimental NNMT-inhibitor research compound. Human dosing has not been established; this page separates mouse studies from a community-reported subcutaneous vial protocol.

name: ADAMAX 1032
short_description: ADAMAX 1032 is an experimental Semax-related analogue sold here as a 10 mg nasal research set. No clinical dose is established; this page uses a clearly labeled community nasal protocol and pump-calibration math.

name: AICAR
short_description: AICAR (acadesine / AICA-riboside) is an AMPK-pathway research compound with human IV pharmacokinetic data and a separate community-reported subcutaneous research protocol.

name: AOD-9604
short_description: AOD-9604 is a modified growth-hormone fragment studied mainly by oral and IV routes. The practical SubQ schedule below is a community protocol, not an approved or clinically validated SubQ regimen.

name: ARA-290
short_description: ARA-290 (cibinetide) is an investigational erythropoietin-derived peptide studied in small human trials. The SubQ tier cards reproduce published 1–8 mg daily study arms and separate them from community vial preparation.

name: BPC-157
short_description: BPC-157 is an experimental peptide with predominantly animal evidence. The SubQ tier cards below reproduce a community protocol and are not a human clinical dosing standard.

name: Cagrilintide
short_description: Cagrilintide is an investigational long-acting amylin analogue studied by once-weekly subcutaneous injection. Tier cards reproduce published Phase 2 monotherapy arms; research-vial mixing is shown separately.

name: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend
short_description: A fixed 1:1 CJC-1295 (no DAC) + Ipamorelin blend with a community SubQ protocol. Human component studies used different molecules/routes and do not validate the fixed blend.

name: CUV100: GHK-Cu + KPV
short_description: Fixed 1:1 research blend containing 50 mg GHK-Cu and 50 mg KPV. The protocol below preserves the exact equal-mass ratio and documents a conservative community-derived SubQ range; no controlled trial has evaluated this finished blend.

name: DIHEXA
short_description: Experimental HGF/c-Met-modulating research compound presented in a nasal-format kit. Published evidence is preclinical; the practical nasal schedule below is a clearly labeled community protocol, not an approved medical dose or a result established in human clinical trials.

name: DSIP
short_description: DSIP (emideltide) is an experimental sleep-related peptide. Human studies used short IV protocols; the SubQ tiers below are community-reported and kept separate.

name: Epithalon
short_description: Epithalon (Epitalon/AEDG) is an experimental tetrapeptide with community SubQ cycles. Human injectable dose evidence is not robust; the four cards map the source-reported 5–10 mg/day for 10–20 days.

name: GHK-Cu
short_description: Injectable GHK-Cu is an experimental copper-peptide research format. Human evidence is strongest for topical use; the SubQ tiers below are community-reported and not clinically validated.

name: GHK-Cu Topical Serums
short_description: Compare GHK-Cu Regular for daily renewal, Pro for intensive copper-peptide care, and Ultra for advanced multi-peptide smoothing and firmness support.

name: GHRP-2
short_description: Synthetic ghrelin-receptor agonist studied for growth-hormone release. Human research includes acute diagnostic and infusion studies, while the SubQ schedule below is a clearly labeled community protocol rather than an approved chronic regimen.

name: GHRP-6
short_description: GHRP-6 is an experimental growth-hormone secretagogue. Human studies used acute IV exposure; the SubQ three-times-daily tiers below are community-derived.

name: GLOW
short_description: GLOW70 is a fixed 70 mg 5:1:1 blend of GHK-Cu, TB-500, and BPC-157. The exact-blend SubQ protocol is community-derived; no human trial validates the combination.

name: GLP1-S: Semaglutide
short_description: Semaglutide is an approved once-weekly SubQ medicine in specific ready-to-use products. Tier cards use the current Wegovy label; research-vial BAC math is kept separate.

name: GLP2-T: Tirzepatide
short_description: Tirzepatide is an approved once-weekly SubQ medicine in ready-to-use products. Tier cards follow the current Zepbound label; research-vial BAC math is separate.

name: GLP3-R: Retatrutide
short_description: Retatrutide is an investigational once-weekly triple agonist. Tier cards reproduce published Phase 2 and official Phase 3 study tracks; research-vial BAC math is separate.

name: Glutathione
short_description: Glutathione antioxidant research record with human intravenous and intranasal studies. The linked product is injection-format, while no validated SubQ schedule was found; the detailed nasal trial protocol is included only as route-specific evidence.

name: HGH 191AA (Somatropin) 15 IU
short_description: Somatropin 15 IU research vial with an official-label reference range shown for comparison. The vial strength is not itself a dose, and equivalence to an approved branded formulation must be verified before any clinical interpretation.

name: HGH 191AA (Somatropin) 24 IU
short_description: Somatropin 24 IU research vial with an official-label reference range shown for comparison. The vial strength is not itself a dose, and equivalence to an approved branded formulation must be verified before any clinical interpretation.

name: HMG (Human Menopausal Gonadotropin)
short_description: Menotropins research product labeled 75 IU FSH activity plus 75 IU LH activity. The practical reference below follows the FDA-labeled MENOPUR SubQ protocol, but dosing is in International Units and cannot be safely entered into this portal’s milligram-only tier cards.

name: IGF-1 LR3
short_description: Modified long-acting IGF-1 analog supplied as a 1 mg research vial. The SubQ tiers summarize community protocols from 20 to 100 micrograms daily; controlled human dosing and long-term safety are not established.

name: Ipamorelin
short_description: Ipamorelin is an experimental growth-hormone secretagogue. Human studies used IV exposure; the practical SubQ tiers below are community/practitioner protocols.

name: Kisspeptin
short_description: Kisspeptin pathway research record with community SubQ tiers for kisspeptin-10. Human studies confirm reproductive-hormone activity, but kisspeptin-10 and kisspeptin-54, intravenous and SubQ exposure, and different product strengths must not be treated as interchangeable.

name: KLOW
short_description: KLOW80 is a fixed 80 mg 5:1:1:1 blend of GHK-Cu, KPV, BPC-157, and TB-500. The exact-blend SubQ protocol is community-derived.

name: KPV
short_description: KPV is an experimental alpha-MSH-derived tripeptide. The SubQ protocol below is community/practitioner-reported; FDA found no human exposure data by any route.

name: Lemon Bottle
short_description: Unapproved fat-dissolving injectable marketed for subcutaneous mesotherapy. Distributor protocols exist, but regulators report unproven efficacy, serious injury risk, and unreliable ingredient identity; no safe customer reminder tier can be established.

name: LIPO-B
short_description: LIPO-B is a non-standardized compounded lipotropic name. This page documents common SubQ volume-based community practice while making clear that the exact quantitative formula, concentration, and finished-product label must be verified first.

name: LIPO-C
short_description: LIPO-C is a non-standardized compounded lipotropic name. This page documents common SubQ volume-based community practice while making clear that the exact quantitative formula, concentration, and finished-product label must be verified first.

name: LIPO-C+
short_description: LIPO-C+ is a non-standardized compounded lipotropic name. This page documents common SubQ volume-based community practice while making clear that the exact quantitative formula, concentration, and finished-product label must be verified first.

name: LIPO-Mino-Mix
short_description: LIPO-Mino-Mix is a non-standardized compounded lipotropic name. This page documents common SubQ volume-based community practice while making clear that the exact quantitative formula, concentration, and finished-product label must be verified first.

name: LIPO Shredder
short_description: LIPO Shredder is a non-standardized compounded lipotropic name. This page documents common SubQ volume-based community practice while making clear that the exact quantitative formula, concentration, and finished-product label must be verified first.

name: MOTS-C
short_description: MOTS-C is an experimental mitochondrial-derived peptide. SubQ tiers are community-derived; published efficacy studies are animal IP models rather than human SubQ trials.

name: NAD
short_description: NAD+ is a coenzyme, not a peptide. The SubQ schedules below are community/pharmacy-reported; published direct human evidence is mainly IV and does not validate SubQ efficacy.

name: PE-22-28
short_description: PE-22-28 is a shortened spadin/sortilin-derived TREK-1 ligand with mouse intraperitoneal evidence and speculative community SubQ tiers. No human dose is established.

name: Pinealon
short_description: Pinealon (EDR) has limited older human evidence using oral capsules. Intranasal use is community-derived; this record documents the linked 10 mg nasal research configuration without presenting it as clinically validated dosing.

name: PT-141
short_description: PT-141 (bremelanotide) has an FDA-approved ready-to-use SubQ comparator and published human dose-ranging arms. Research-vial reconstitution is separate arithmetic.

name: RTT60: Retatrutide + Tirzepatide
short_description: RTT60 is a fixed 60 mg research blend containing 20 mg retatrutide and 40 mg tirzepatide. The weekly tier cards show exact 1:2 blend arithmetic and low-range community exposures; no clinical study supports combining these overlapping incretin agonists.

name: Selank
short_description: Selank is a tuftsin-derived synthetic heptapeptide studied primarily by the intranasal route. This record separates the registered Russian 0.15% nasal-drop instructions from historical clinical ranges and from calculation-only use of PepStack’s standalone 10 mg vial, included 5 mL BAC, and nominal 0.1 mL-per-spray device.

name: Selank + Semax Blend
short_description: A 1:1 intranasal research blend containing 10 mg Selank and 10 mg Semax. With the included 5 mL BAC and nominal 0.1 mL spray device, each spray contains 0.2 mg Selank plus 0.2 mg Semax. Blend-specific controlled human dosing has not been established.

name: Semax
short_description: Semax has registered Russian intranasal 0.1% and 1% formulations with indication-specific protocols. This record focuses on nasal administration and keeps routine cognitive research separate from acute-stroke hospital dosing.

name: SNAP-8
short_description: SNAP-8 (Acetyl Octapeptide-3) is a topical cosmetic peptide ingredient. Human evidence is limited to specific finished or multi-ingredient formulations and does not establish a universal concentration or finished-product claim.

name: SS-31
short_description: SS-31 (elamipretide) has an FDA-approved ready-to-use SubQ product for Barth syndrome and separate community low-dose protocols. Research-vial BAC math is not the approved formulation.

name: Tesamorelin
short_description: Tesamorelin has FDA-approved SubQ formulations with exact but non-interchangeable preparation. Tier cards separate FDA and legacy human doses from community research-vial math.

name: Tesamorelin 10 mg + Ipamorelin 5 mg
short_description: TI15 is a fixed 2:1 blend containing 10 mg tesamorelin and 5 mg ipamorelin. The four SubQ tiers use independently recalculated total-blend arithmetic and clearly state the amount of each component.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1: TA1
short_description: Thymosin Alpha-1 (thymalfasin) has official and human SubQ protocols. Exact formulation and concentration matter; the common 5 mg/mL research-vial mix exceeds FDA-identified solubility/study-strength boundaries.
